# T12 evals — numbers first, no hairline text
Run from repo root. R=src/components. CSS set C="$R/public/landing.module.css $R/public/signin.module.css $R/access/AccessCard.module.css $R/cover-real/real.module.css $R/cover-real/RealHome.module.css $R/ui/tiles.module.css $R/covers/covers.module.css"
1. E1 landing removals — cmd: `grep -c "pointD\|rowS\|statM\|styles.story" src/components/public/Landing.tsx` — expect: output `0` — PASS if 0 (grep exit 1 is fine)
2. E2 signin whyD — cmd: `grep -c "whyD" src/components/public/SignIn.tsx` — expect: `0` — PASS if 0
3. E3 access card copy — cmd: `grep -c "No card needed" src/components/access/AccessCard.tsx; grep -c "Trial: starts fresh" src/components/access/AccessCard.tsx; grep -c "Privacy" src/components/access/AccessCard.tsx` — expect: `0`, `1`, then >=1 — PASS if all three hold
4. E4 tour text gone — cmd: `grep -rc "20-second tour" src | grep -v ":0$"` — expect: no output — PASS if empty
5. E5 FactItem quote vs citation — vitest `tests/components/t12-numbers-first.test.tsx`, test "FactItem shows citation, not quote": render FactItem with fact {quote:"QUOTE_SENTINEL_XYZ", citation:"Your document, Page 3"}; expect: getByText("Your document, Page 3") present, queryByText("QUOTE_SENTINEL_XYZ") null, and container.textContent does not contain "QUOTE_SENTINEL_XYZ" — PASS if test green
6. E6 FactItem status — same file, test "FactItem status text": render with status "extracted_unverified" -> no status element (container has no element with class matching /status/ and no text "unverified"/"Unverified"); render with status "conflicting" -> status element present with non-empty text; also "unknown", "user_confirmed", "reviewed_reference" each render a non-empty status element — PASS if test green
7. E7 RealHome captions — same file, test "RealHome tiles: captions only on Next step": render RealHome with fixture data; expect tiles "Policies", "Sum insured", "Next renewal" have no caption element; "Next step" tile still has its caption; "Cover per person" soon tile (HomeView/SoonBento) has no caption — PASS if test green
8. E8 type floor px — cmd: `grep -nE "font-size:\s*([0-9]|1[0-2])(\.[0-9]+)?px|font-size:\s*var\(--fs-12\)|font-weight:\s*[123]00\b" $C | wc -l` (with C expanded) — expect: `0` — PASS if 0
9. E9 fs-12 gone in buttons — cmd: `grep -c "fs-12" src/styles/buttons.css` — expect: `0`; and `grep -A3 "k-soon" src/styles/buttons.css | grep -c "fs-13"` >=1 — PASS if both hold
10. E10 tokens untouched + landing stats kept — cmd: `git diff feat/ui-integration -- src/styles/tokens.css | wc -c` — expect: `0`; and `git diff feat/ui-integration -- src/components/public/Landing.tsx | grep -E '^\+' | grep -cE '[0-9]+[%+x]?\s*<'` equals 0 new numeric literals added — PASS if tokens diff is 0 and no new stat values added (stat value + label elements still in Landing.tsx: `grep -c "statV\|statL" src/components/public/Landing.tsx` >=1)
11. E11 no secrets added — cmd: `git diff feat/ui-integration | grep -iE '^\+.*(secret|password|api_key)'` — expect: no output — PASS if empty
12. E12 verify — cmd: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` — expect: exit 0
